It's made by taking any tree branch and just tying a string to either end, so don't expect much in the way of combat effectiveness.|Inventory|TotK}}{{Name Ref|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 4 |durability = 16 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boko Bow}} Boko Bows are basic wooden [[Bow]]s that are used by regular [[Bokoblin]]s throughout [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]]. They are made by tying a string to either end of a tree branch, so they are not considered to be very effective in combat. Being made by Bokoblins, they belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype as a result.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} If scanned using the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance of spawning a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Boko Bow, along with other [[Bokoblin Gear]]. Being made from wood, Boko Bows will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they are unable to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Boko Bows do not conduct [[Electricity]], nor do they attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_004" |Life = 16 |Power = 4 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Boko Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 4 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} Boko Bows appear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Boko Bows are wielded by Bokoblins.
